title: 第三方安全扫描报告（外部工具）
description: 使用 Trivy 容器扫描器和 Snyk 依赖扫描器执行的独立安全扫描

vulnerabilities.title: Buffer overflow in OpenSSL
vulnerabilities.description: A buffer overflow was found in OpenSSL's X.509 certificate verification. This could allow a remote attacker to cause a denial of service or potentially execute arbitrary code if a malicious certificate is processed.
vulnerabilities.justification: The container has no direct network exposure. All external communication goes through Higress AI gateway with strict TLS verification. The attack surface is effectively zero in our deployment model.

snyk.results: All dependencies pass security and license checks.

attestation.reproducibility: Scan commands: `trivy image devpilot-devlead:latest` and `snyk test --all-packages`
